brief:
Democrat Adam Hamawy, a volunteer surgeon who treated Palestinians in Gaza during Israel's military operations, defeated Republican Gregg Mele to represent New Jersey's 12th Congressional District, Middle East Eye reported.

Hamawy's election adds a voice to Congress with direct experience of the conflict. His medical work in Gaza formed a key part of his campaign platform in the Democratic-leaning district.
dek: Gaza volunteer surgeon Adam Hamawy wins US House seat in New Jersey Democrat Adam Hamawy, who treated Palestinians in Gaza during Israel’s genocide, has defeated Republican Gregg Mele to represent New Jersey’s 12th Congressional District.
title: Gaza surgeon Hamawy wins New Jersey House seat
